verdict.rationale: HMRC's public employer-registration page says you can check when to expect your letter about your registration. That gives some visibility into where an application stands, but it is an expected-timing check rather than a lookup of your specific case status. Account-based tools such as managing Corporation Tax online sit behind sign-in, not on public pages. Missing for 10: actual per-case status lookup for filings, applications and cases; coverage beyond employer registration (VAT, Corporation Tax, MTD); detail on how the check works; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: You can check when to expect your letter from HMRC about your registration.
